title: The best robot vacuum deals this Black Friday: huge savings on Dyson, Roborock, Dreame and Shark
excerpt: Some of the best robot vacuums we've ever tested are less than half price, and I've rounded them up for you here.
content_html:
As TechRadar's Homes Editor, I've been keeping a close eye on this year's Black Friday deals on robot vacuum cleaners — and I'm very impressed. If you've been pondering pulling the trigger on a robovac this week, there's never been a better time, with heaps of models plummeting to record-low prices. In the US, one of the best deals I've spotted is the Narwal Flow 2 for $949.99 at Amazon (was $1,499.99). It's a supremely versatile robot for hard and carpeted floors, and boasts a dock that washes and dries the rotating roller mop with hot water and air for hygiene.

• Browse all today's best Black Friday deals

In the UK, I was particularly impressed to see the excellent Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 down to £569.99 (was £1,199.99). It's a fantastic all-rounder that currently occupies the top spot in our roundup of the best robot vacuums, and its excellent performance on all floor types means it's the model that we'd recommend to most people. At less than half price, it's outstanding value as well.
